content: Mbǝghanambǝg Yesu kǝ dadda vǝca
Sahi ba nǝ Yesu sii ma aghwa, kaa gatǝgaan kǝ uudaha baɗyaka
Kaa sagau kǝ dadda vǝc da vakaana, kǝla kǝ iin kǝ ghunj tǝvuukwaana amaa, “Yaazhigǝla, ma haighanthaiga, mbǝkwimbǝga.”
Kaa vǝlla dǝv kǝ Yesu tapǝna kǝ dadda vǝcna amaa, “Haiyananthaiga, mbambǝga.” Batwatswatsǝra, kaa mbǝgambǝg kǝ iina.

Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Faffǝg kǝ hyǝmmiya tagar bi aanji kǝ war kǝ dǝgiti aa dzǝgardzǝgǝn biya, dǝg mardamarǝg kǝ ghǝragh vak zhiila kǝsuufa, agha vǝlda kǝ baiku bandkwa tagada na adzahadzaha Musa. Ɓagnaɓag kwana kiyava fadghǝr kǝ dlamakǝlaawa taakiya mbǝghambǝga.”
Mbǝghanambǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ kwatanaha tlauja Rum maamala
Dagha ba nǝ Yesu damma Kafarnahum, ngal dagau kǝ tlauja Rum maamal da vakaan da ghalgaan taakiya,
“Yaazhigǝla, kwatnahar hǝngan hǝnyah ǝmtsamtsan nǝ vǝgha, hǝɓa dlaɗ ba vaivaiya.”
Aiyam Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Ən dagau da mbǝgaana.”
Kaa ngugwamgug kǝ tlauj maamalna amaa, “Yaazhigǝla, tlanal bi nai kǝskǝgh kǝ sagau sa vǝgyar biya, tagdatag ba kǝ ǝlbǝg kalti kwatnahar da mbǝga.

Aɗaba kai dǝghǝrar ndakwani ǝn mazhangyil kǝ kwarǝga uuda, mǝng dlaɓ tlaujah mazhangyil kǝskaiya, ǝn tagardatag kǝ pallaatǝr taakiya, ‘Dǝga,’ kaa dagauwa. Kwatlǝrǝn dlaɓ ǝn ɗaagantdaaga taakiya, ‘Sawa,’ sagauwa, Akwama taganartag dlaɓ kǝ kwatlǝrǝna, ‘Ɓagnaɓag kǝ dǝgit ǝntkwaha,’ kaa ɓagaana.”
Cinngha ba nǝ Yesu ǝndkwaha, kaa ɓa jappǝr kǝ iina, aiyama kǝ lii gatǝgaana, “Ən tagkurtag kǝ jiira, tapanna bi kǝ tlǝkǝnatlǝg kǝ uud dǝ fadghǝr ǝndkwan ma Izrail biya.
Ən tagkurtaga, baɗyak nǝ uudah ar da sii dǝ sǝga ard sagat dǝ sǝga ar da cihurgan ǝmtaɗ dǝ Ibrahim ard Ishaku ard Yakub vaka za kaffa hwaɗag ma tlǝkǝsǝra ghǝrazhigǝla.
Aɗaba uudahi ɓadlavtǝrna kǝ iitǝr nǝ tlǝksǝra ghǝrazhigǝla, da ɗiivtǝrdǝm damma gurtla, vakavaki ar da tuug nǝ iitǝr ard ghwada dǝv dǝ tlǝrɗa.”
Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ tlauja maamalǝna, “Dǝgdaasa, da ɓagakɓag nǝ uud mbakyarvad fadghǝragha.” Kaa mbǝg nǝ kwatnaha nǝ iina batwatsǝra.
Mbǝhanambǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ babba uusa Bitrus
Dagha ba nǝ Yesu da vǝgya Bitrusa, kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ iin kǝ babba uusa Bitrus ɓǝlgan njǝkǝn fǝɗa.
Tapǝna kǝ iin kǝ dǝva uusiina, kaa mbǝgambǝg kǝ iin tuuk kǝ fǝɗiina, ngal ciiga ɓagtǝra kǝ dǝgzǝga.
Mbaghanambǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ uudah ba ɗyaka
Ɓǝlaa ba hwaasa, kaa sǝdǝvsǝga kǝ uudah kǝ lii ciɓǝg shatanah baɗyak da vak Yesu, tagada ba ǝlbǝg kalti, ngal sagal shatanahahaan ma vǝghaatǝra, mbahǝnan baz lii yangbiya.
Tǝdvad kwan wa righavant nǝ dǝgiti tagavda tǝdvad tlayang Ishay taakiya,
Dlaɗ ma gata Yesu
Nǝgha ba nǝ Yesu kǝ uudah baɗyak faɗǝga tǝghǝr kǝ iina, ngal tagartag kǝ iin kǝ mbǝrzahaan maraa dzǝva dagal dat ghyaba kwah kǝ ghaiya yuwa haiya.
Ngal sagau kǝ dadda tsaga adzahadzah da vakaana, amaa taa kǝ iina, “Dadda tsaga dǝgita, ǝn gatakgatǝg badǝm vakavaki agha dagal nǝnga.”
Ngugharangug nǝ Yesu amaa, “Mbayakaha ar da afkahaatǝra, ɗiikaha dlaɓa mǝng vakavaka hǝnnganahaatǝra, Zǝra Uuda maay vaka hǝnnganan biya.”
Am nǝ pall ma mbǝrzahaan taa kǝ iina, “Yaazhigǝla, ǝn dǝgaadǝg ndan ǝn hǝɗnan kǝ daadara.”
Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Gatkwagatǝga, aa hǝɗarhǝɗǝg lii ǝmtsaharaǝmtsahǝg kǝ zaraabahaatǝri ǝmtsaraǝmtsǝga.”
Kyaɓalghanakyaɓalǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ kalangasa
Dagha ba nǝ Yesu damma pɛrayuwa, kaa gatǝgaan kǝ mbǝrzahaana.
Kaa ciig kǝ ghabag ard fǝɗ ma yuwahaiya, fǝgharzhafǝg baz yu ghubǝɗa saas damma pɛrayuwa, Yesu dlaba hǝnahaara.
Kaa dagau kǝ mbǝrzahaan ar ciyanta, am nǝ iitǝra, “Yaazhigǝla, katkǝmndkatǝga wakǝm tǝ ɗuula ǝmtsǝga.”
Aiyama taa kǝ iitǝra, “Aujilbǝg kǝskuram gǝdzǝg ǝndkwani, kuramǝn dǝ fadghǝr hǝɗiikǝna?” Kaa ciig kǝ iin cagara kǝ gyi kǝ fǝɗǝn ard ghubǝɗǝga yuwa, kaa kyaɓalǝgakyaɓalǝga.
Kaa ɓa jappǝr kǝ mbǝrzahaana, aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Hulfakwar kǝ uud wana, baz fǝɗ ard ghubǝɗǝga yu ar cinngarnucinngni?”
Mbǝghanambǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ lii ciɓǝg nǝ shatanaha
Tsǝgwa ba nǝ Yesu ma haaya Garisaha, kaa sagau kǝ uudah bu kwa ciɓtǝr shatanah sa vak Yesu, gǝdzǝvtǝrgǝdzǝg ba vaivaiya, aɗaba ar ndzǝga bamma gǝtlaha, maay wa ta kwahiin kǝ ɗuul biya.
Kaa huulǝg kǝ iitǝr ar taakiya, “Au lambagh dǝ kǝmnd Zǝra Daadamazhigǝli? Agha sa vǝlkǝmnd dlaɗ ba sart ndakwani ɓagaa biya?”
Mǝng nǝ maandala agyaragyara ghavzah ar piig kǝ dagalaatǝra.
Ngal ba ghalgaan kǝ shatanahaan kǝ Yesu taakiya, “Akwama sǝghkǝmndadasǝga, ɗiikǝmndarsɗiig damma gyǝɗya ghavdzahaana.”
Aiyama taa kǝ iitǝra, “Damdǝg ciya,” Kaa daas kǝ iitǝr damma ghavzahiina. Baɗǝm gyǝɗya ghavzǝn kaa ǝmdǝra daay kǝ iitǝr bawatswats damma yuwahaiya, ngal ruug kǝ iitǝra.
Kaa ǝmndǝra daas kǝ lii piya ghavzahaana. Daragha ba nǝ iitǝr damma kǝssa, kaa tagaan kǝ iitǝr kǝ dǝgitahi dzǝghaar dǝ lii ciɓtǝr nǝ shatanahǝn baɗǝmma.
Ngal sagal kǝ uudah ma kǝsiin baɗǝm da tlǝgaraa Yesu. Nǝghara ba nǝ iitǝra, kaa ghalgaan kǝ iitǝr maa ɗuwars kǝ lardaatǝra.
